stances.claim: The Pro Ecclesia et Pontifice Award belongs to all co-workers on the Cathedral restoration -- donors, contractors, architects, engineers, carpenters, masons -- not to CJP alone. The award is a collective recognition of their 'labor of enduring love.'
stances.rhetorical_move: collective-attribution: de-centering the individual honoree in favor of the community of workers

stances.claim: The structural restoration of Manila Cathedral was accomplished WITHOUT an 'as-built' plan, without written formal requests, and without a pre-planned blueprint -- sustained purely by faith, donor trust, and expert improvisation.
stances.rhetorical_move: without-any-plan narrative as testimony to faith-driven accomplishment

stances.claim: Tessie Sy Coson is admirable 'not because of, but in spite of' being BDO chair and the wealthiest woman in the country -- she has remained simple, modest, unaffected, and unassuming. This negative-causation formula ('in spite of, not because of') is a recurring CJP principle for evaluating genuine character.
stances.rhetorical_move: 'not because of, but in spite of' character standard -- CJP's signature test for genuine virtue

stances.claim: Faith -- not judicial connections or political campaigning -- brought CJP to the Supreme Court. The 1995 vow ('I hold office by God's grace') is re-dedicated here: 'I dedicate all that I am, and all that I will ever be, to Him who is the Source of everything.'
stances.rhetorical_move: vow-rededication as performative speech act closing the acceptance
stances.confidence: asserted with cross-reference to 1995 BLD sharing at Cuneta Astrodome

notable_anecdotes: The absent 'as-built' plan mystery: no architectural plan of the Cathedral existed in either Church archives or City of Manila archives -- workers had to dig under the belly to discover pyramid-like pilings.

Carbon-fiber miracle: every marble column was carefully chipped, wrapped in carbon fiber and injected with epoxy -- ALL marble covers restored to their original places without any breakage or blemish.
Dome workers: intrepid laborers hung on steel cables from the Cathedral dome ceiling to perform the four Rs.

Cardinal Tagle's text from Rome: 'Deciding to close the Cathedral a few weeks after my assumption as Archbishop tore my heart apart... God was preparing us, and the Cathedral warmly welcomed [Pope Francis in 2015]. May God be glorified always!'

Fr. Michael Nolan's double role: taught CJP the Our Father, Hail Mary, and Glory Be in the 1950s; and snatched the young CJP -- as FEU CSO president -- away from Marxism, helping him found the NUSP, 'the largest student organization in our country up to now.'

Late Leni's two conditions for marriage: (1) forget ideological and political aspirations; (2) understand her difficult role as an obedient wife who still loves our Lord Jesus Christ more than anyone in the world.

Tessie Sy Coson: CJP taught her commercial law at Assumption College in the late 1960s; now 'she has become my cherished mentor in banking, finance, management, and entrepreneurship.' Formula: 'not because of, but in spite of' being BDO chair and the wealthiest woman in the country.

'Faith Brought Me to the Supreme Court': the October 18, 1995 BLD sharing at the Cuneta Astrodome -- one week after joining the Court -- where CJP first uttered the vow he rededicates at this ceremony.

one_paragraph_summary: Delivered at a Eucharistic celebration at the Manila Cathedral on September 18, 2024, this award acceptance speech for the Pro Ecclesia et Pontifice -- the highest honor the Holy Father grants lay persons -- opens with CJP declaring himself 'unworthy and undeserving' but acknowledging the award's two grounds: his presidency of the Manila Cathedral Basilica Foundation and his spiritual journey as 'a frail servant.' Citing Matthew 6:1, he accepts because the Vicar of Christ initiated the recognition. The first half pays tribute to all co-workers on the Cathedral's four Rs (retrofit, restrengthen, restore, renovate): five major donor families -- Ramon Ang and Cecil; the late Dr. George S.K. Ty (represented by Arthur/Zandra, Alfred/Cherry, Alessandra/Alvin); Fernando Zobel de Ayala (Jaime Augusto was in Singapore); Alberto and Sylvia Lina (who donated 23 Dutch computerized Carillon Bells to replace the 17-ton belfry bells); and one anonymous donor. DM Consunji donated their mark-ups and margins. He narrates the engineering miracle: no 'as-built' plan existed anywhere; workers dug under the belly, discovered pyramid-like pilings, chipped the marble columns, wrapped them in carbon fiber and injected epoxy -- and restored every marble cover without a single breakage. Cardinal Tagle's text from Rome recalls closing the Cathedral with a torn heart, but 'God was preparing us, and the Cathedral warmly welcomed Pope Francis in 2015.' The second half acknowledges spiritual rescuers: Fr. Michael Nolan (FEU chaplain who taught the three basic prayers and snatched CJP from Marxism, leading to the NUSP); late Leni (two conditions for marriage -- abandon political aspirations; understand her difficult vocation); Ambassador Tita de Villa (led CJP into Catholic lay leadership); and Tessie Sy Coson -- former student who became mentor, admirable 'not because of, but in spite of' being BDO chair. He closes by rededicating the 1995 Cuneta Astrodome vow: 'I dedicate all that I am, and all that I will ever be, to Him who is the Source of everything' -- inviting the congregation to rise and proclaim 'To God Be the Glory.'
